(1) we study distributionally robust optimization problems where the ambiguity set depends on the decision variable; (2) for finite support case, the decision dependent distributionally optimization problems can be reformulated as a linear, conic, or Lagrangian dual program; and (3) for the continuous support, we provide reformulations for decision dependent distributionally models based on moment, covariance, and Kolmogrov-Smirnov ambiguity sets.
we provide a general framework for decision dependent distributionally robus optimization models with different ambiguity sets.

(i) decision dependence in the distributionally robust stochastic optimization model can be incorporated in the ambiguity set; (ii) for a finite support case, the resulting model can be reformulated into an equivalent model with a finite number (or a polynomial number) of constraints; and (iii) for the continuous support model, the resulting model has a reformulation with a finite number or a polynomial number of constraints for moment, covariance or Kolmogorow Smirnov ambiguity sets.
